purpose: CoreOptions.enableRunfiles (`--enable_runfiles`, analysis/config/CoreOptions.java:954-961: a TriState, default `auto`) as a configuration value: config_setting(values) converts the expected value with Converters.TriStateConverter (common/options/Converters.java:133-156: `auto`, or a boolean spelling true/1/yes/t/y, false/0/no/f/n, case-insensitive; else `'X' is not a boolean`) and compares it with the configured TriState (ConfigSetting.optionMatches: AUTO unless set, so `true` does not match by default); the option has boolean syntax (`--enable_runfiles` = yes, `--noenable_runfiles` = no, OptionDefinition.usesBooleanValueSyntax), the last occurrence wins, it propagates to exec configurations (builtin_exec_platforms.bzl:237) and `query` accepts it (CoreOptions). Motivation: after filegroup `output_group`, `build --nobuild //src/ts/...` on ~/code stopped at `in values attribute of config_setting rule @@aspect_bazel_lib+//lib:enable_runfiles: select() on build option 'enable_runfiles' is not implemented in the native profile` (aspect_bazel_lib 2.22.5 lib/BUILD.bazel:37-40, selected by aspect_rules_js's js_binary `enable_runfiles` attribute).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/enable_runfiles_option: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (or the recorded part of it) (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal; a successful `run` case's stdout (the program's output) equal; a `query` case's stdout equal; the recorded outputs' existence after the command equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: Default (auto): `auto` and `AUTO` match; `true`, `yes`, `1`, `TRUE`, `false`, `no` do not (a js_binary-shaped bool attribute selected on the `true` setting is False); the exec tool sees the same; `--enable_runfiles=auto` is the default.

`--enable_runfiles`, `--enable_runfiles=yes`, `=YES`: true/yes/1/TRUE match (also in the exec configuration, the option propagates); `--noenable_runfiles`, `--enable_runfiles=false`: false/no match; `--noenable_runfiles --enable_runfiles`: the last wins.

`--enable_runfiles=maybe`: `While parsing option --enable_runfiles=maybe: 'maybe' is not a boolean` (exit 2, also for `query`); `--noenable_runfiles=yes :: Unexpected value after boolean option: --noenable_runfiles=yes`; a config_setting value `maybe`: `in values attribute of config_setting rule //pkg:er_bad: error while parsing configuration settings: While parsing option --enable_runfiles=maybe: 'maybe' is not a boolean` (exit 1); `query --enable_runfiles` is accepted; `--nobuild --noenable_runfiles //pkg:all` analyzes.
known_divergences: Exit codes of command-line errors: genuine 2, native 1 (native's single error channel); success/failure always agrees.
Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
